description: Runtime asset manifest for the cabt Pokemon TCG safe agent. Declares every non-standard asset required to run the agent, the unit tests, and local cabt games. Git-tracked source is integrity-checked by Git (sha256 null); untracked external competition/starter-kit assets carry sha256 + size so a reviewer can confirm the correct files are supplied out-of-band.

asset_type_legend.external: Provided by an installed package / environment, not this repo tree.

assets.name: cabt_api
assets.acquisition: From the official cabt competition starter kit (not committed here). Place at starter_kit/api.py.

assets.name: cabt_sim_bindings
assets.acquisition: From the official cabt competition starter kit. Place at starter_kit/sim.py.

assets.name: cabt_game_driver
assets.acquisition: From the official cabt competition starter kit. Place at starter_kit/game.py.

assets.name: cabt_utils
assets.acquisition: From the official cabt competition starter kit. Place at starter_kit/utils.py.

assets.name: starter_kit_package_init
assets.acquisition: Empty package marker from the starter kit. Place at starter_kit/__init__.py (may be an empty file).

assets.name: competition_deck
assets.acquisition: 60-card competition deck (one integer card ID per line) from the starter kit. Place at starter_kit/deck.csv.

assets.name: cabt_native_engine
assets.acquisition: Native x86-64 ELF engine from the starter kit. NOT committed (native binary; .gitignore excludes *.so). Place at starter_kit/libcg.so. Note: its internal RNG is seeded from std::random_device (OS entropy) and exposes no seed API, so game trajectories are not reproducible.

assets.name: cg_root_symlink
assets.acquisition: Create at repo root: ln -s starter_kit cg  (makes 'from cg.api import ...' resolve).

assets.name: cg_inner_symlink
assets.acquisition: Create inside starter_kit: ln -s . cg  (lets 'cg' resolve from within the package too).

assets.name: kaggle_environments_cabt
assets.acquisition: pip install kaggle-environments==1.30.1 (ships the built-in 'cabt' environment). Verified by import + env registration.
